detail.longDescription:
cross-posted from: https://lemmy.ml/post/53284374
[https://lemmy.ml/post/53284374] I’m glad to announce v0.4.7 release
[https://github.com/basiliscos/syncspirit/releases/tag/v0.4.7]! Syncspirit
[https://github.com/basiliscos/syncspirit/] is continuous peer-to-peer realtime
syncrhonization tool. It implements BEP
[https://docs.syncthing.net/specs/bep-v1.html] protocol and provides seamless
interoperability with existing syncthing [https://syncthing.net/] nodes and
clients.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/basiliscos/syncspirit/refs/heads/master/docs/fltk-overview.gif
[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/basiliscos/syncspirit/refs/heads/master/docs/fltk-overview.gif]
You can download ready-to-use binaries for Linux x86_64
[https://github.com/basiliscos/syncspirit/releases/download/v0.4.7/syncspirit-fltk-v0.4.7-x86_64.AppImage]
(AppImage), Windows 32 bit
[https://github.com/basiliscos/syncspirit/releases/download/v0.4.7/syncspirit-win32-v0.4.7.zip]
(WindowsXP is supported), Windows 64 bit
[https://github.com/basiliscos/syncspirit/releases/download/v0.4.7/syncspirit-win64-v0.4.7.zip]
and Mac OS X
[https://github.com/basiliscos/syncspirit/releases/download/v0.4.7/syncspirit-fltk-v0.4.7-darwin-arm64.zip]
(Apple silicon). Notable changes (since previous v0.4.5 announce): - [core,
fltk] allow to use file patterns (PCRE-syntax) accept or ignore local files into
cluster - [core] add start offline option - [fltk, win32, os x] add system tray
icon - [fltk] use menu instead of toolbar - [core] introduce services layer
(allow stop/start/restart of networking) - [core] dns resolver actor: randomly
choose ip address of resolver server - [core, fix] more reliably connect to
relays.syncthing.net [http://relays.syncthing.net] - [core, win32, bugfix] use
utf8 for displaying error messages - [core, win32, bugfix] allow to use long
file paths (260+ symbols) Syncspirt source code
[https://github.com/basiliscos/syncspirit/archive/refs/tags/v0.4.7.tar.gz] uses
GPLv3 license. Any feedback is welcome! WBR, basiliscos.
